title: CUB train-only positive privileged-part Oracle reproduction gate
rationale: PartImageNet mechanism development stopped after three failed Oracle gates. This experiment tests whether the privileged-part mechanism has a positive ceiling on a benchmark where the closest prior work reports gains.

data.privileged_information: 15 visible part locations, rendered as synchronized 10-pixel-radius supervision maps

arms.GLOBAL: Layer4-adapted ResNet-50 with global average pooling and one classifier.
arms.PRPOOL_FULL_KEYPOINT_ORACLE: The same layer4 adaptation with 15 supervised sigmoid attention maps plus one complementary map, per-map attention-weighted average pooling, L2-normalized concatenation, and one classifier.

optimization.train_augmentation: synchronized random resized crop at scale 0.7-1.0 and horizontal flip with left/right keypoint channel swaps
optimization.selection: No hyperparameter search in this gate.

primary_endpoint: five-fold out-of-fold balanced accuracy on the frozen 10-shot official-train subset

go_no_go.on_go: Freeze the positive mechanism and create a separate train/validation missingness protocol for MCAR, MAR, MNAR, and support-isolation.
go_no_go.on_no_go: Do not develop an MNAR correction method with the current pretrained-backbone family; reposition the project as a diagnostic/benchmark study or reproduce the paper's exact original stack.
